# upGrad USA

> > upGrad USA delivers online degree programs and executive certifications from global universities to US professionals seeking career advancement in business, data science, and AI leadership.

upGrad USA partners with prestigious institutions like Liverpool Business School, Golden Gate University, IIIT Bangalore, and University of Waterloo to offer accredited master's degrees, doctorates, and executive certifications. The platform specializes in blended learning models combining online coursework with immersive experiences for working professionals.

## Doctorate Programs

- [Doctor of Business Administration / DBA Degree Online for US Learners](https://www.upgrad.com/us/dba-course): DBA degree programs overview from Golden Gate University and partner institutions
- [Doctorate of Business Administration Program Online from Golden Gate University](https://www.upgrad.com/us/doctor-of-business-administration-from-golden-gate-university-us): Golden Gate University DBA program details, curriculum, and admissions information
- [DBA in Emerging Technologies with Generative AI Concentration from GGU](https://www.upgrad.com/us/dba-emerging-technologies-specialization-in-gen-ai-ggu-us): DBA program with Generative AI specialization from Golden Gate University
- [Doctorate of Business Administration Program Online from ESGCI](https://www.upgrad.com/us/doctor-of-business-administration-from-esgci): DBA program from ESGCI with blended learning and thesis supervision
- [DBA Program Online from Rushford Business School](https://www.upgrad.com/us/dba-from-rushford-business-school): Rushford Business School DBA program with global immersion opportunities

## Executive & Leadership Programs

- [Generative AI Degree Courses & Certification Programs Online for US Learners](https://www.upgrad.com/us/cxo-courses): Executive courses in Generative AI and leadership from partner universities
- [Chief Technology & AI Officer (CTAIO) Program from University of Waterloo](https://www.upgrad.com/us/chief-technology-and-ai-officer-program-university-of-waterloo): University of Waterloo CTAIO program for tech leadership and AI strategy
- [Chief Technology & AI Officer (CTAIO) Certification Program](https://www.upgrad.com/us/ctaio-iimu-iiit): CTAIO certification from IIM Udaipur and IIIT-Bangalore collaboration
- [Chief Revenue Officer (CRO) Executive Certificate by IIM Kozhikode](https://www.upgrad.com/us/chief-revenue-officer-cro-program-iim-kozhikode): IIM Kozhikode CRO executive certificate for revenue leadership and strategy
